Manifest.Name: 可能是更好的料斗
Manifest.Author: PROPZHANG
Manifest.Description: 一个进料斗可以连接任意数量的出料斗（有序 = 优先级，列表可滚动），每个出料口有独立的 7 条件可多选过滤（5 个物品/类型条件 + 属性白名单/属性黑名单；物品/类型条件：搬运全部物品 / 白名单物品 / 白名单类型 / 黑名单物品 / 黑名单类型，物品类型按游戏 60 种物品类型过滤、黑名单优先、冲突自动移除并红字提示）。夜间结算、进料斗窗口「立即转移」、物品放入/移动触发、出料斗双击等原版触发链路全部自动按多口分流：物品按 identifier 分组，先尝试第 1 个出料口，放不下再尝试下一个，keep 每组只扣一次。把进料斗拖到出料斗上是「追加连接」（新链接插入到第一个「全部物品」兜底链接之前；第一次连接默认「全部物品」，与原版一致；之后新增的连接默认「只送列表」空列表，需要去设置过滤），左键（双击/激活）或右键进料斗选择原版「设置」都打开同一个统一配置窗口：原版进料斗窗口功能（颜色/立即转移/复制/粘贴/order/keep/自动触发）与多口管理（链接列表/上移/下移/断开、候选出料口连接）以及每个出料口的内嵌过滤编辑（三种模式、物品列表、点选世界物品加入；Esc 先取消点选、再按 Esc 关窗）全部合并在这一页里，不再有第二个配置页。数据保存在进料斗物品自身的 tag（随存档保存），原版 link/mode/filter 三个字段始终同步为第 1 条链接——因此卸载本模组后进料斗退化为原版单口（只连第 1 口）可正常读取，不报错、不丢物品。设置窗口支持与「储物窗口缩放」mod 一致的拖动缩放（50%-150%，以左上角为基准、向右下拖动放大/向左上拖动缩小、滚轮缩放、双击恢复 100%；停靠后窗口可进入黑边区域），并按每个料斗记忆窗口大小与位置（与「不要遮挡 / Don't Block（含 Plus，ID dont_block_plus）」的「记住窗口位置」联动：该选项关闭时本窗口不记忆位置；黑边/分辨率变化后自动归位，停靠后可进入黑边）；可选：进料斗/出料斗图标上显示原版 #N 编号；属性白/黑名单（赃物/赝品/荧光莓品质等 71 种属性），编号文字为醒目的黄色 #FFCD3C；设置页「编号大小」滑条可调 50%~300%（默认 150% = 原版 1.5 倍），旁边带料斗图标 + 黄色编号的实时预览（拖动滑条编号随之变大变小）；关闭/卸载后恢复原版颜色与字号。A single intake hopper can feed any number of outlet hoppers (ordered = priority, the list scrolls), each outlet with its own seven-condition filter (5 item/type conditions + attribute white/black lists; all items / white-list items / white-list types / black-list items / black-list types; item-type filtering over the 60 game types, black wins, conflicts are auto-removed with red feedback). Nightly settlement, the intake window "transfer now" button, item add/move triggers and outlet double click all use the multi-outlet routing automatically: items are grouped by identifier and tried on outlet 1 first, then on the next ones; the keep count is subtracted once per identifier group. Dragging the intake onto an outlet appends a link (a new link is inserted before the first all-items fallback link; the first connection defaults to all items like vanilla, later links default to an empty allow list that the player configures); both the vanilla left click activation (double click) and the vanilla Configure entry (right click the intake -> Configure) open the same single configuration window: the vanilla intake window content (color row, transfer now, copy/paste, order, keep, auto triggers) plus the outlet link management (ordered list, move up/down, unlink, candidate outlets) and the inline per-outlet filter editor (three modes, item list, click-to-pick from the store; Esc cancels the pick first, the next Esc closes the window). There is no second configuration window. The data lives in a tag of the intake item itself (saved with the save file) and the three vanilla link/mode/filter fields always mirror the first link, so after removing this mod the hopper degrades to the vanilla single-outlet behaviour (first outlet only) and loads without errors or item loss. The settings window supports the same drag-to-resize interaction as the Container Window Scale mod (50%-150%) and remembers the size/position per hopper, linked to the Don't Block / Don't Block Plus (id dont_block_plus) remember-position option (position is not remembered when that option is off; the window re-clamps after letterbox/resolution changes); optional: show the vanilla #N label on hopper icons in a bright yellow (#FFCD3C). A "Number size" slider in the mod settings adjusts it from 50% to 300% (default 150% = 1.5x the vanilla size) with a live preview (hopper icon + yellow number) that grows/shrinks while dragging; the vanilla color and font size are restored when disabled.
